secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible provider that powers the AI Lab tools (portfolio assistant, fashion studio, research explainer, concept explorer). Defaults to OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/keys), with Groq supported by swapping AI_BASE_URL/AI_MODEL in .env.base44-defaults (https://console.groq.com/keys). Without it the tools show an honest "not connected" state instead of answers.
